ctaHeading: Ready to pour in Taylors Lakes? Let's get started.
aboutText: Based in Ravenhall, Taylors Lakes Concrete proudly services Taylors Lakes and surrounding suburbs in Melbourne's west. We guarantee to answer all calls or reply within 12 hours, and our quotes are always comprehensive, itemised and detailed. You will receive photos, up to 50 references, and a 25 minute DVD presentation. With a display office open 24 hours, seven days a week, and all workmanship guaranteed, we make your concreting project seamless from start to finish.
servicesHeading: What We Pour in Taylors Lakes
servicesText: From driveways to exposed aggregate and everything in between, Taylors Lakes Concrete delivers above-standard materials and guaranteed workmanship across Ravenhall, Taylors Lakes and Melbourne's west.
